errors.text_span: Die horizontale Achse stellt die verschiedenen Branchen dar
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis shows percentages, not the categories or industries.

errors.text_span: Die vertikale Achse zeigt den Prozentsatz der Betriebe
errors.evidence: The vertical axis shows categories (industries and business sizes), not percentages.

errors.text_span: Innerhalb jeder Branche werden für jede Betriebsgröße eigene Balken angezeigt
errors.evidence: The chart does not show separate bars for different business sizes within each industry; each bar represents a single category or industry.
The description does not mention that the chart represents the proportion of businesses affected by the minimum wage increase according to the caption.
The description does not mention the sorting order of the categories, which is not strictly alphabetical.
